answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The mirror of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sonnet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
